name: Dramaturgy

description.content: While healthy and running, use <Active Ability> to gain [25%] [Haste] for [2s], [Exhausted] for [40s], and one random effect:

items: You gain a random rare item with random add-ons.

description.content: The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.

quote: "Take the part. It's a good movie, he says. What's the worst that can happen?" -Nicolas Cage
